isolated_candidates.candidate_description: QK owning AIV final8head Native DIV/rint/inverseRoPE directly publishes original contiguous root heads; removes attnOi GM, rope_cs/merge_norm/native_heads tasks; original QK pipeline unchanged
isolated_candidates.postload_fix: Re-export unchanged QR_OK/KV_OK metadata expected by prepare_csa_model; all existing math/source bytes unchanged.
isolated_candidates.v2_fix: Explicit INT32 casts for Tile scalar operands; no algorithm change.
isolated_candidates.v3_fix: All checked output uses one MTE3 store path; fallback scalar writes only UB Tile then stores it. No GM scalar/MTE3 mixture.
isolated_candidates.v4_fix: Page-bound reduction uses eight aligned rows, unchanged exact predicate; no SDK edit.
isolated_candidates.v5_fix: A3 INT32 AND-scalar unavailable: exact nonnegative remainder via subtraction and shifts, matching nalinaly physical-plan idiom.
isolated_candidates.backend_fix: INDEX->INT32->FP32 bound conversion required by existing PTO backend
isolated_candidates.inline_return_fix: explicit tuple values instead of forwarding function-call expression; math unchanged
isolated_candidates.return_annotation_fix: infer exact Tensor shape from returned tuple, rather than generic incomplete pl.Tensor annotation
isolated_candidates.output_alias_fix: preserve original root Out heads binding; helper writes original buffer and returned alias is not rebound across scope
isolated_candidates.li_layout_fix: current ISA does not support Vec ColMajor TEXTRACT; reuse same lane final li_transfer already produced in exact Native update, no extra GMstat output
